summary.text: Chris Luchey is the Democratic candidate for Georgia House of Representatives District 103 in the November 3, 2026 general election; he also ran for the seat in 2024.
He describes a background as a former steelworker and automotive union employee who has also worked as an NBA scout and agent.

paragraphs.text: Luchey was born in Detroit, Michigan, according to Ballotpedia, which lists career experience in marketing, as a steelworker and automotive worker, and as a high school basketball coach and Sunday school teacher.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, he said he had worked in sports as an NBA scout and agent and as an advocate in the Name, Image & Likeness antitrust lawsuit.
Luchey won the 2024 Democratic primary for District 103 unopposed and lost the general election to incumbent Republican Soo Hong, 60.5 percent to 39.5 percent.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on May 19, 2026.
His 2024 survey answers listed infrastructure funding, expanding Medicaid and healthcare access, and support for labor, voting and equality rights as key messages.
